purpose: Expose the condition labels visible in the two public GEO series records without acquiring a source-file body, inferring an individual-cell state, or mixing sample, spot and cell levels.

sources.method: 10x single-nucleus RNA sequencing and Visium spatial transcriptomics
sources.sourceScope: 77 mid-thoracic mouse spinal-cord samples across series-record condition labels.

sources.method: 10x single-nucleus Multiome ATAC plus Gene Expression
sources.sourceScope: 16 mid-thoracic mouse spinal-cord RNA and ATAC series-record samples at uninjured, D7 and 2M labels.

conditions.title: Uninjured source-label group
conditions.sourceMaterial: mid thoracic spinal cord of mouse

conditionAxes.name: injury status
conditionAxes.interpretationBoundary: A source sample group is not an individual cell population or a whole-spinal-cord baseline.

conditions.established: The public series lists three single-nucleus RNA-sequencing samples labelled uninjured from mid-thoracic mouse spinal cord.
conditions.notEstablished: No cell identity, sex, exact age, lesion-equivalent comparator, coordinate, effect size or project-space registration is established here.
conditions.nextGate: Review the processed metadata object and its terms before any record-level or count-level adapter is proposed.

conditions.title: Post-SCI source-label time-course groups
conditions.sourceMaterial: mid thoracic spinal cord of mouse

conditionAxes.name: time after SCI
conditionAxes.interpretationBoundary: The literal series labels are retained; OLD is not converted to a numeric timepoint or age definition.

conditions.established: The public series lists post-SCI time-course-labelled single-nucleus RNA-sequencing sample groups at the displayed literal labels.
conditions.notEstablished: The index does not identify compatible injury model, severity, sex, cell state, individual cell trajectory, causal change or a shared coordinate frame across these groups.
conditions.nextGate: Require sample-level metadata and a prespecified compatible-comparison rule before any numerical analysis or displayed contrast.

conditions.title: Injury-mechanism source-label groups
conditions.sourceMaterial: mid thoracic spinal cord of mouse

conditionAxes.name: injury model
conditionAxes.interpretationBoundary: The hemi label is retained exactly as supplied and is not expanded into an unverified surgical protocol.

conditions.established: The public series lists single-nucleus RNA-sequencing samples with contusion and hemi mechanism labels.
conditions.notEstablished: A shared lesion geometry, severity, timing, cell composition, functional outcome, causal effect or mapping to a current atlas entity is not established.
conditions.nextGate: Pin the sample metadata fields and define a model-stratified comparison protocol before any model contrast is calculated.

conditions.title: Severity source-label groups
conditions.sourceMaterial: mid thoracic spinal cord of mouse

conditionAxes.name: severity source label
conditionAxes.interpretationBoundary: These are literal source labels, not inferred force, displacement, tissue-sparing percentage or clinical severity units.

conditions.established: The public series lists single-nucleus RNA-sequencing samples with the displayed severity source labels.
conditions.notEstablished: The physical meaning, ranking comparability, model context, cell-level response, causal dose relation or relevance to another injury system is not established.
conditions.nextGate: Obtain the source protocol and metadata definitions before translating any severity label into a measurement or ordered analysis.

conditions.title: Male sex-label source group
conditions.sourceMaterial: mid thoracic spinal cord of mouse

conditionAxes.name: sex source label
conditionAxes.interpretationBoundary: The index records only the visible male-labelled group; it does not create a sex comparison or infer unlisted counterpart samples.

conditions.established: The public series lists three single-nucleus RNA-sequencing samples with a male source label.
conditions.notEstablished: No female comparator, sex effect, sex-by-injury interaction, cell-level identity or generalization across sexes is established.
conditions.nextGate: Verify the complete sample metadata and an explicit comparison design before displaying a sex-stratified analysis.

conditions.title: Drug source-label groups
conditions.sourceMaterial: mid thoracic spinal cord of mouse

conditionAxes.name: drug source label
conditionAxes.interpretationBoundary: Abbreviations remain as literal source labels; the index does not expand them into dose, route, timing, control or efficacy claims.

conditions.established: The public series lists single-nucleus RNA-sequencing samples with chabc, gfp, meth and mino source labels.
conditions.notEstablished: Intervention identity, treatment protocol, efficacy, safety, causal molecular effect, behavioural benefit or translation to people is not established.
conditions.nextGate: Review the per-sample protocol and treatment metadata before interpreting an abbreviation or creating any intervention contrast.

conditions.title: Visium spatial-section source-label groups
conditions.sourceMaterial: mid thoracic spinal cord of mouse
conditions.aggregationLevel: spatial sections; not a cell-level record

conditionAxes.name: spatial section label
conditionAxes.interpretationBoundary: Section identifiers are source labels; they do not provide a project transform, voxel spacing, axis orientation, an individual-cell position or a named spinal segment.

conditions.established: The public series lists 24 spatial samples arranged as four lettered section labels for each of six numeric source identifiers.
conditions.notEstablished: A spatial sample is not an interneuron, cell coordinate, anatomical registration, 3D reconstruction, morphology, connectivity record or whole-spinal-cord map.
conditions.nextGate: Pin a source object with specimen, coordinate units, axes, origin, scale and asset-level reuse decision before any source-local spatial display.

conditions.title: Multiome source-label groups
conditions.sourceMaterial: mid thoracic spinal cord of mouse
conditions.aggregationLevel: source-series RNA and ATAC sample labels only

conditionAxes.name: multiome condition source label
conditionAxes.interpretationBoundary: Literal RNA and ATAC series labels are indexed without asserting a same-cell file join, a shared barcode, or a project-level multimodal correspondence.

conditions.established: The public multiome series lists RNA and ATAC source-sample labels for UN, D7 and 2M condition groups in mid-thoracic mouse spinal cord.
conditions.notEstablished: No current adapter establishes a same-nucleus join, feature matrix, cell type, chromatin effect, spatial coordinate, cross-series equivalence or registration.
conditions.nextGate: Pin object-level metadata, modality pairing and barcode provenance before any same-nucleus or cross-modality analysis is considered.

releaseDecision.permitted: Display, filter and export this bounded condition-label index alongside the public source record.
releaseDecision.forbidden: Do not download a source body, bundle processed metadata, infer cell identity or treatment effect, call a spatial sample an interneuron, merge incompatible conditions, create a same-cell link, add a coordinate or create REG.
releaseDecision.nextCuratorGate: A curator must approve a version-pinned object inventory, asset-level terms, sample metadata and a condition-compatible analysis plan before any numerical source-data adapter is proposed.
